vedic_reference.note: The name Saubhagya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'सुभाग्' (subhag) which means 'auspiciousness'. It is also mentioned in various Hindu scriptures such as the Mahabharata and the Ramayana. For example, in the Mahabharata, the character Draupadi is referred to as 'Saubhagya' because she was given five husbands, who were all kings, making her the most fortunate woman in the kingdom.
